subject: Post-call: GreenLeaf buying path & latency/SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@greenleaf.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@greenleaf.ai>, procurement@greenleaf.ai
Date: 2027-01-19T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + buying path questions after today's call

Hi Vivek — thanks for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can map internal stakeholders and timelines.

What we care about (high level):
- Latency: user-facing chat flows should feel instant; target 95th percentile latency < 150ms for single prompt responses at typical message lengths (~40–80 tokens).
- Cost: economics matter — we’re aiming for a hosted+burst model but want unit cost under ~$0.25 per 1k tokens (ballpark).
- Deployment mode: prefer hosted for time-to-value but open to dedicated if isolation or predictable throughput is required.
- SLA: Production SLA needs 99.9% monthly uptime and an escalation path to engineering.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you send a concise checklist mapping who at GreenLeaf we should be involving (economic buyer / procurement / security / legal)?
2) Can you share a short SOC 2 / compliance summary and any references for data residency?
3) Pricing band examples for Hosted vs Dedicated for our profile (chat throughput ~200 QPS peak, avg token length ~60).

I attached a short doc with our internal notes (greenleaf_requirements.pdf). We’re aiming to finalize vendor short-list within 3 weeks. Procurement is looped in.

Best,
Alex Morris
Director of Product
GreenLeaf AI

Attachment: greenleaf_requirements.pdf (application notes, expected traffic and timeline)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + buying path questions after today's call

Thanks Alex — good to meet your team. Short answers + proposed next steps below.

Recap and ownership suggestions (who to pull in):
- Economic buyer: Sarah Li (CTO) — responsible for budget / platform choices.
- Procurement: procurement@greenleaf.ai — will handle SOW / PO / contract redlines.
- Security & compliance: security lead (please share name) — will validate SOC 2, data retention, encryption.
- Platform/Infra stakeholder: product/infra manager (for deployment mode and throughput).

Compliance and materials: Attached is our SOC 2 one-pager and a short security summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf). It includes KMS/HSM options, VPC/private deployment checklist, and audit-log retention defaults. If GreenLeaf requires a full report we can coordinate an NDA + secure portal access.

Latency and cost guidance for your profile (200 QPS peak, ~60 tokens avg):
- Hosted API (Redwood standard): typical 95th p95 for short chat ~120–180ms depending on concurrency; recommended to enable KV prefix caching for frequently repeated prompts to reduce p95. Estimated cost band: $0.18–$0.30 per 1k tokens depending on model variant and caching.
- Dedicated (reserved pool): more predictable p95 in the 80–140ms range, lower unit cost when committed volume; supports strict isolation and guaranteed throughput.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): if you need on-prem or strict residency; latency depends on your infra. We provide ops & rollout docs.

SLA: standard enterprise SLA can be 99.9% with defined escalation contacts; for committed Dedicated contracts we provide financial credits for uptime breaches.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (pilot -> procurement -> PO) by EOD.
2) Neha will follow up with a short security questionnaire and a suggested pilot scope sheet.
3) Please confirm the security lead name and whether GreenLeaf prefers Hosted-first pilot or Dedicated evaluation.

Cc'ing Neha (security/compliance) and Karthik (solutions) to pick up materials and pricing bands.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, pilot-scope-sheet.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@greenleaf.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T14:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + buying path questions after today's call

Alex — following up with the security/compliance lens and a short checklist to speed procurement.

Quick security checklist (we’ll deliver the items below once we have an NDA or secure portal access):
- SOC 2 Type II summary (attached one-pager already); full report available under NDA.
- Data residency options: Hosted (region pins available), Dedicated (customer VPC), Private (on-prem).
- Encryption: at-rest AES-256, in-transit TLS 1.3, KMS integration for customer-managed keys.
- Audit logs: per-route traces, token-level cost breakdown; retention customizable for enterprise packages.
- Pen-testing & SLAs: red-team report available on request; annual penetration testing schedule documented.

Questions for GreenLeaf security team so we can tailor the pilot:
1) Do you have a mandatory data residency or regulatory requirement (e.g., must stay in us-west)?
2) Any restrictions on storing KV caches or user conversation history?
3) Will you require customer-managed KMS?

Pilot scope suggestion (attached pilot-scope-sheet.xlsx):
- 2-week hosted pilot simulating peak 200 QPS + a canary dedicated cluster for deterministic latency testing.
- Success criteria: p95 latency <= 150ms for chat happy path, <1% error rate, cost delta report.

If you confirm the security contact and residency constraints we’ll finalize the MAP and provide a cost estimate range for Hosted vs Dedicated for the pilot.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@greenleaf.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@greenleaf.ai>, procurement@greenleaf.ai
Date: 2027-01-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + buying path questions after today's call

Vivek / Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. Answers below to help you finalize the MAP.

Security contact: Sarah Li (CTO) will be primary for architecture/security questions; I’ll loop Andrew Chen (security lead) in the next email.
Residency: must keep production data in us-west for the first 12 months; hosted region pin is fine.
KV cache: allowed for transient caching but no long-term storage of PII — we will annotate what counts as PII separately.
KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys for the pilot if feasible.

Procurement: procurement@greenleaf.ai will take the MAP and SOW; they asked for two pricing scenarios: hosted pilot estimate and Dedicated reserved 3-month demo pricing.

We are comfortable with the proposed pilot scope. Timeline: vendor short-listing complete by Feb 8, pilot to start mid-Feb if we proceed.

Attachments from our side: greenleaf_requirements.pdf (already shared); I’ll send Andrew's contact and procurement PO template in a separate thread.

Looking forward to the MAP — please include an explicit escalation contact and draft SLA section for Dedicated.

Best,
Alex Morris
Director of Product
GreenLeaf AI
